lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A minor Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the second vertical line from the anterior, near the dorsal ridge transition.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines in the mid-torso section terminate mid-flank, creating abbreviated segments that do not reach the ventral fringe.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15-20% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial chevron between the orbital regions, two distinct white spots on the lateral cheek, and a dark, long-haired ventral fringe extending from the lower neck to the groin.
